violation_type.title: Safety Requirements of SCPE - Installed, Maintained and Cleaned (26 TAC §746.4953(4))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements of SCPE - Installed, Maintained and Cleaned
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have manufacturer instructions regarding which ages of children are able to use the soft contained play equipment.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have manufacturer instructions regarding which ages of children are able to use the soft contained play equipment.
At the follow-up inspection, the bounce house was being used by children, four children were bouncing at the same time and the bounce house is not fully enclosed.
